translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Market structure uses CONFIRMED fractal pivots: swing_high(k)/swing_low(k) become known only k bars after the pivot, so no future swing point is used. swing_*(k, j) is the j-th most recent pivot; swing_*_age gives bars since that pivot (used to order points and project trend lines).

strategies.name: Bearish Engulfing at Resistance
strategies.entry: close[1] > open[1] and close < open and open >= close[1] and close <= open[1]
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 325 mean net -0.5%; intraday trades 3653 mean net -0.096%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Shooting Star / Bearish Pin Bar
strategies.entry: (high - max(open, close)) > 2 * abs(close - open) and (min(open, close) - low) < 0.2 * (high - low)
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 355 mean net -0.6%; intraday trades 3593 mean net -0.102%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Evening Star
strategies.entry: close[2] > open[2] and abs(close[1] - open[1]) < 0.3 * (high[1] - low[1]) and close < open and close < (open[2] + close[2]) / 2
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 297 mean net -0.485%; intraday trades 3502 mean net -0.088%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Tweezer Bottom
strategies.entry: abs(low - low[1]) / low < 0.001 and close > open
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 264 mean net -0.257%; intraday trades 4968 mean net -0.148%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Fair Value Gap Tap
strategies.entry: low[2] > high[4] and low <= low[2] and low >= high[4]
assumptions: literal catalogue indices: gap between High[t-4] and Low[t-2], tapped by Low[t]
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 184 mean net -0.148%; intraday trades 2196 mean net -0.145%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Support-Turned-Resistance Flip
strategies.entry: any_of(close > highest(high, 20)[1], 4)[2] and low <= valuewhen(close > highest(high, 20)[1], highest(high, 20)[1]) * 1.01 and close > valuewhen(close > highest(high, 20)[1], highest(high, 20)[1]) and close > open
assumptions: Resistance_Zone = the 20-bar high broken between t-5 and t-2; touch = low within 1% above it
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 180 mean net -0.746%; intraday trades 2126 mean net -0.137%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Cup and Handle Breakout
strategies.entry: between((highest(high, 120)[20] - lowest(low, 100)[20]) / highest(high, 120)[20], 0.15, 0.35) and (highest(high, 20) - lowest(low, 20)) / highest(high, 20) < 0.12 and lowest(low, 20) > (highest(high, 120)[20] + lowest(low, 100)[20]) / 2 and close > highest(high, 20)[1]
assumptions: cup = the 120 bars before the last 20 (depth 15-35%); handle = last 20 bars, depth < 12%, in the cup's upper half; roundness not tested
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 54 mean net -1.989%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Symmetrical Triangle Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) < swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and close > swing_high(3) + (swing_high(3) - swing_high(3, 2)) / (swing_high_age(3, 2) - swing_high_age(3)) * swing_high_age(3) and volume > sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: upper trendline projected through the two most recent swing highs to the current bar
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 96 mean net -0.712%; intraday trades 1833 mean net -0.147%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Rounding Bottom (Saucer)
strategies.entry: slope(close, 30)[30] < 0 and slope(close, 30) > 0 and slope(close, 30) > slope(close, 30)[15] and slope(close, 30)[15] > slope(close, 30)[30] and close > highest(high, 60)[1]
assumptions: positive curvature (a > 0) approximated by a monotonically rising 30-bar regression slope from negative to positive over 60 bars
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 29 mean net -1.5%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Bat Harmonic Pattern
assumptions: Bat ratios (AB 0.382-0.5 XA, AD 0.886 XA) on confirmed pivots; D is known k bars after the pivot, so RSI is read at confirmation
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 0 mean net -%; intraday trades 3 mean net -0.22%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: 1-2-3 Trend Reversal (Sperandeo)
strategies.entry: sma(close, 50) < sma(close, 50)[20] and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and swing_low_age(3) < swing_high_age(3) and swing_high_age(3) < swing_low_age(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))
assumptions: prior downtrend = SMA50 falling over 20 bars; point 1 = low, bounce peak, point 2 = higher low, trigger close above the peak
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 38 mean net -1.559%; intraday trades 621 mean net -0.095%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Point & Figure Double/Triple Top Breakout
assumptions: percentage boxes on the bar high/low path (one bar can move the column once); 3-box reversal; breakout = rising X column one box above the highest of the previous 2 (double) or 3 (triple) X-column tops
